tools.name: customs_data_gap_check
tools.description:
Best for: "which products have no HS code?" or "run a customs readiness check on this". Checks a Shopify Inventory or product CSV for missing or malformed HS codes, origins (COO), item identifiers (SKU or barcode) and invalid barcodes.
Returns: summary counts (null where the file has no such column)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: customs_data_gap_check, get_feedback_reply · Private data: customs_data_gap_check · Public sink: eu_duty_estimate, submit_feedback · Destructive: customs_data_gap_check, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: customs_data_gap_check, get_feedback_reply · Private data: customs_data_gap_check · Public sink: eu_duty_estimate, submit_feedback · Destructive: customs_data_gap_check, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "landed_cost_estimate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
